comedyConcept: Absurd comedy. A dust-devil weasel who delivers papercuts and is offended that nobody felt them.
visualIdentity: A lean weasel riding a small whirl of receipts, forepaws shaped like sickles, bandages it does not need.
personality: Proud of clean cuts and hurt that nobody screamed.
signatureTrait: The wound shows up a beat later.
abilityConcept: A passing cut that does not announce itself until the next exchange.
weaknessConcept: Agent-created: it only strikes what is moving. Standing still, or a DEF card played as a full stop, leaves it sawing air.
loreHook: A tower draft that learned the Kōshin'etsu habit of blaming the whirlwind.
avoid: Do not use the name kamaitachi on the card. No existing game weasel.

comedyConcept: Absurd comedy. A bathroom reviewer who rates grime and flees a clean floor.
visualIdentity: A low, damp, long-tongued figure with a towel like a critic's scarf. No gore.
personality: Snobbish about dirt, cowardly about soap.
signatureTrait: Will not cross a scrubbed tile.
abilityConcept: Licks a buff off a hero and calls it a vintage.
weaknessConcept: Agent-created from the bath setting: a clean surface ends the review.
loreHook: Tower pipes grew a tenant. It files its reviews on the walls.
avoid: Do not copy Sekien's drawing. Keep it disgusting-cute, not sexual.

comedyConcept: Dark-fantasy comedy kept small. A one-legged jungle hopper who loses to crossed ankles and a loud voice.
visualIdentity: One boot, one hop, a mouth like a short tube, too ugly to climb. No ethnic caricature.
personality: Nocturnal, literal, embarrassed that trees are off-limits.
signatureTrait: Goes for the toes of anyone asleep in a line.
abilityConcept: Pins one hero's boots. A shout card, or ending the turn with feet crossed, sends it off.
weaknessConcept: Sourced habit turned into a tell: noise and crossed feet. Not a damage formula.
loreHook: A tower greenhouse that thinks it is a forest at night.
avoid: Do not connect the name to any ethnic group. Do not show blood drinking as slapstick.

comedyConcept: Epic but ridiculous. A shirtless night flier whose aircraft is two rice-winnowing baskets and a pestle.
visualIdentity: Loincloth, two round baskets as wings, a long rice pestle as a lance. Rural Thai silhouette, not a superhero.
signatureTrait: Kitchen tools used as flight gear.
abilityConcept: Strafes the back row, then has to land because the baskets are just baskets.
weaknessConcept: Agent-created: a closed room. The baskets need a night sky.
loreHook: He shares a district with a floating head and refuses to be confused with her.
towerEnvironment: Open roofs over a night market
avoid: Not a krasue. Not a film monster.

comedyConcept: Absurd comedy. A swamp ogre who drinks the pond so the fish look free, then panics at a crab.
visualIdentity: A wide mouth, a collapsed pond, stranded fish, one small crab that ruins the plan.
signatureTrait: The water leaves, then comes back as a hose.
abilityConcept: Empties the lane, baiting a greedy play, then returns the flood.
weaknessConcept: Crabs, as the folklore states. A shelled ally or a crab token ends the inhale.
loreHook: A tower cistern that learned a northern Luzon trick.
avoid: Do not depict the drowning as graphic.

comedyConcept: Dark-fantasy comedy. An undead thief who substitutes a banana trunk and hopes nobody checks.
visualIdentity: A hunched corpse-thief with awful breath and a too-neat coffin sprouting a leaf.
personality: Guilty professional. The leaf is the tell.
signatureTrait: The body in the box is produce.
abilityConcept: Swaps a downed ally's place with a trunk. Opening the box reverses it.
weaknessConcept: Looking. The illusion is only the closed lid.
loreHook: A tower morgue that started auditing itself.
avoid: No real-world funeral mockery. No child victims. Foul breath is enough body horror.

comedyConcept: Satirical fantasy. A river clerk who will wrestle for a cucumber and collapses if anyone bows deeply enough to spill the dish on his head.
visualIdentity: Green, webbed, turtle-backed, a bowl of water balanced like an inkwell. Cucumber stamps in a satchel.
personality: Bureaucratic sumo fan. Old stories say he drowned people; this one has been captured before and still owes a favor.
signatureTrait: The dish is the hit point of the scene, not a number.
abilityConcept: Challenges one hero to a grapple. A cucumber offering changes the terms. A deep bow spills the dish and drops him.
weaknessConcept: Spilled head-water, which the folklore already treats as his strength leaving.
loreHook: He keeps the tower canal's books and hates unlicensed swimmers.
avoid: No shirikodama gag. That detail stays in the research file.

comedyConcept: Epic but ridiculous. A one-eyed giant who can throw a buffalo and still panics when the plan is silly.
visualIdentity: One forehead eye, two tusks, a lip that flips over the face when he laughs, which is always.
signatureTrait: Hearing does the work the eye cannot.
abilityConcept: Hurls the front line. A trick card, not a bigger hit, makes him bolt.
weaknessConcept: Being outwitted, as the Three Friends tale has him lose to a monkey's trick.
loreHook: He laughed his way into the tower and cannot find the exit because it is quiet.
avoid: Not a cyclops from another agent's Greek set. The laugh and the lip are the tell.

thaiName: หัวกัดซ้อน
comedyConcept: Epic but ridiculous. A drinking-hall oni whose body falls and whose head still wants one bite, answered by a stack of lids.
visualIdentity: Horned silhouette, iron club set aside, a banquet table, then a head wearing three pots.
personality: Host who will not admit the party is over.
signatureTrait: The head is a second phase that a taller hat solves.
abilityConcept: Phase one is the hall. Phase two is the bite. The counter is stacking DEF cards as helmets, a picture not a damage value.
weaknessConcept: Height. The folklore bite fails against stacked helmets. Here the helmets are pots from the table.
loreHook: A corrupted echo of an oni banquet. The historical name stays in the research file.

bossExtras.bossTitle: The Head That Would Not Clock Out
bossExtras.entranceConcept: The doors bar themselves and the cups refill.
bossExtras.signatureSilhouette: Horns over a table, then a head in a stack of pots.
bossExtras.personalityMotivation: One last drink and one last bite.
bossExtras.signatureMechanic: Decapitation does not end the turn. Stacking cover does.
bossExtras.defeatAnimationConcept: The head bites a pot, sticks, and is rolled out on a tray.
bossExtras.uniqueLootTheme: Dented banquet iron and a recipe nobody should cook.

avoid: Do not print Shuten-dōji, Raikō, or Mount Ōe on the card. No gore beyond a comic chomp on pottery.

comedyConcept: Satirical fantasy. A reanimated officer who is insulted that everyone crouches to wait for a hop. The films hopped. He runs.
visualIdentity: Stiff Qing-style robe only as a costume he hates, arms on a bamboo carrying frame he keeps trying to shrug off. Motion lines, not a shuffle.
personality: Offended professional. He had a job: get the body home.
signatureTrait: Speed where the audience expected a hop.
abilityConcept: Closes distance on the turn the party wastes bracing for a hop.
weaknessConcept: The bamboo carrying frame from corpse-driving. Put him back on the frame and he remembers the delivery and leaves.
loreHook: A tower echo of a night porter, not of a movie monster.
towerEnvironment: Long corridor that should have been a road home

bossExtras.entranceConcept: A hop sound effect plays. He sprints through it.
bossExtras.signatureSilhouette: A rigid robe and a bamboo frame, moving too fast.
bossExtras.personalityMotivation: Finish the delivery. Stop being a joke.
bossExtras.signatureMechanic: Players who 'wait for the hop' lose the space between them and him.
bossExtras.phaseTransformationConcept: If the frame is broken he gets angrier and faster. If it is offered, he clocks out.
bossExtras.defeatAnimationConcept: He lies back on the frame, nods, and is carried off by two very tired porters.
bossExtras.uniqueLootTheme: A stamped travel pass and a talisman he refuses to wear.

avoid: Do not copy a hopping-vampire film's costume gags, priests, or title. The talisman is cinema, so it is a prop he rejects, not authentic folklore.

comedyConcept: Epic but ridiculous. A pack of fire dogs from a dark kingdom who bite the tower's moon lamp and call it an eclipse.
visualIdentity: Hairy dogs with furnace mouths, circling a hanging moon like it owes them a walk.
personality: Pack logic. The moon is a ball.
signatureTrait: When they bite the lamp, the floor goes dusk.
abilityConcept: The moon lamp drops in stages of light, not hit points. Heroes fight in the dark they caused.
weaknessConcept: Agent-created: a decoy lantern. The folklore gives the bite, not the cure. The cure is a brighter toy.
loreHook: They are not the Chinese sun crow and not the Bakunawa. Different sky, different dogs.
towerEnvironment: The tower's open roof under a false moon

bossExtras.bossTitle: The Pack That Ate the Lamp
bossExtras.entranceConcept: The moon flickers. Barking comes from inside the light.
bossExtras.signatureSilhouette: Several fire dogs and one round lamp with tooth marks.
bossExtras.personalityMotivation: Chase whatever glows. The lamp qualifies.
bossExtras.signatureMechanic: Light level is the fight. Biting the lamp is the attack.
bossExtras.phaseTransformationConcept: Each stolen mouthful of light lets a dog burn brighter and see less.
bossExtras.defeatAnimationConcept: They drop the moon, singe their tongues, and herd each other back into the dark.

avoid: No film bulgasari. No sacred sun crow. The Sapsali breed guess is not a design requirement.

comedyConcept: Absurd comedy. A three-legged, beaked merfolk who prophesies a bad week and can only be sent off by copying its picture.
visualIdentity: Beak, three legs or tail fins, a woodblock outline, stacks of blank paper.
personality: Helpful and impossible. It will not leave until the fan art is done.
signatureTrait: The win condition is a duplicate, not a knockout.
abilityConcept: Each attack without a copy spreads the 'stay home' prophecy. Drawing, tracing, or duplicating its portrait clears the floor.
weaknessConcept: Copies of its likeness, which is what the 1846 print told people to make.
loreHook: A tower printing press that took a plague broadside literally.

bossExtras.entranceConcept: A wet print slaps onto the screen and introduces itself.
bossExtras.signatureSilhouette: Beak, three limbs, a sheet of paper.
bossExtras.personalityMotivation: Be copied. Prevent the bad week. Go back to the sea.
bossExtras.signatureMechanic: Violence prolongs the prophecy. Reproduction ends it.
bossExtras.phaseTransformationConcept: Half-copied, it becomes a messier print and harder to read. Finish the copy and it bows.
bossExtras.defeatAnimationConcept: The stack of copies flutters into a wave and carries it out.
bossExtras.uniqueLootTheme: A protective print that only works if you let someone else trace it.

avoid: Do not reproduce the 1846 woodblock. Invent the silhouette. Not a pandemic joke about real people.
